nodes.label: MviViewModel base class (toState, Eagerly shared)
nodes.rationale: Eagerly sharing avoids scan restarting from its initial value after 5s in background, which would lose form input or flash Loading.

nodes.label: formatRupees expect/actual (en-IN grouping)
nodes.rationale: JDK NumberFormat cannot group digits the Indian way, so ICU is used on all targets.

nodes.label: safeFlow / safeCall (single catch in data layer)
nodes.norm_label: safeflow / safecall (single catch in data layer)

nodes.label: Use cases (one class per action)
nodes.rationale: ViewModels depend on use cases only; thin pass-through use cases are an accepted cost of SOLID.

nodes.label: Outcome<T> errors as values
nodes.rationale: Failures are values so the stream stays alive after an error and Retry works; ViewModels contain no catch.

nodes.label: Project structure (androidApp, iosApp, sharedUI, data, domain)
nodes.norm_label: project structure (androidapp, iosapp, sharedui, data, domain)
nodes.rationale: AGP 9 forces the Android entry point into its own module; Kotlin visibility (internal) is the guard keeping sharedUI off :data classes.

nodes.label: Testing and quality gates (JVM fakes, Turbine, Kover)
nodes.norm_label: testing and quality gates (jvm fakes, turbine, kover)

nodes.label: Dumb UI (composables render state, forward intents)
nodes.norm_label: dumb ui (composables render state, forward intents)

nodes.label: MVI unidirectional (Intent, UiState, NavEvent)
nodes.rationale: One StateFlow<UiState> and one SharedFlow<NavEvent> per screen; state is a pipeline of reducers, nothing flows backwards.

nodes.label: No mappers above the data layer
nodes.norm_label: no mappers above the data layer
nodes.rationale: ViewModels and UI use domain models directly; entities and mappers stay internal to :data so the schema can change without touching the domain.

nodes.label: Database principles (paise, immutable history, derived never stored)
nodes.norm_label: database principles (paise, immutable history, derived never stored)

nodes.label: Rent increase feature (Raise rent card with Undo)
nodes.norm_label: rent increase feature (raise rent card with undo)

nodes.label: ReminderSync resync model (plan, scheduler)
nodes.rationale: A local notification cannot check whether pending is zero when it fires, so reminders are a resync of a derived plan, not a repeating timer. iOS caps pending notifications at 64.

nodes.label: app_settings table (single row)
nodes.rationale: Settings live in the database so a backup or restore is one atomic transaction.

nodes.label: Platform pieces (photo, backup files, notifications) as UI-only expect/actual
nodes.norm_label: platform pieces (photo, backup files, notifications) as ui-only expect/actual

nodes.label: Backup file (JSON, BackupCodec, GoldenBackups)
nodes.rationale: Entities are serialized directly; the format is frozen with the schema and validated before touching data; restore is one transaction preceded by an automatic snapshot.

nodes.label: Reminder mute (remindersMutedMonth)
nodes.rationale: Mute is tied to the month of the latest bill, so the next bill resumes reminders with no cleanup job.

nodes.label: Backup and restore (share sheet, Undo last restore)
nodes.norm_label: backup and restore (share sheet, undo last restore)

nodes.label: Meter photo (camera, gallery, crop, OCR suggestion)
nodes.norm_label: meter photo (camera, gallery, crop, ocr suggestion)
nodes.rationale: The reading is only suggested; the landlord checks it against the photo preview and the full bill math before saving.

nodes.label: Reminders (create bills, rent pending, Stop this month)
nodes.norm_label: reminders (create bills, rent pending, stop this month)

nodes.label: Ledger (bills and payments merged by date)
nodes.norm_label: ledger (bills and payments merged by date)

nodes.label: Pending (derived balance, PendingCalculator)
nodes.rationale: Computed from bill lines minus unvoided payments so Home updates by itself and nothing can drift.

nodes.label: Renter status (No bill, Paid, Late, Part paid, Unpaid)
nodes.norm_label: renter status (no bill, paid, late, part paid, unpaid)

nodes.label: Part paid, Unpaid, Late, Due day
nodes.norm_label: part paid, unpaid, late, due day

nodes.label: Still to collect (late amount, Not due yet)
nodes.norm_label: still to collect (late amount, not due yet)

nodes.label: Still to collect in detail (Home)
nodes.rationale: One number hides what to do: late means call today, not due yet means wait, unbilled renters are not in the number at all.

nodes.label: ADR 0001 Pending is computed, never stored
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001 pending is computed, never stored

nodes.label: bill table
nodes.rationale: A bill is a snapshot of lines, rate and readings; unique on (renterId, month); can be deleted (ADR 0009) and Undo reinserts the same id.

nodes.label: payment table (voidable)
nodes.rationale: Payments are voided, not deleted, so Undo and an audit trail work; they are not linked to a bill.

nodes.label: Ideas not building now (Money page, FY statement, deposit)
nodes.norm_label: ideas not building now (money page, fy statement, deposit)

nodes.label: Remove a wrong bill (newest bill only, Undo)
nodes.norm_label: remove a wrong bill (newest bill only, undo)

nodes.label: ADR 0009: A wrong bill is removed and made again
nodes.norm_label: adr 0009: a wrong bill is removed and made again

nodes.label: ADR 0002 (bill is a snapshot, never edited)
nodes.norm_label: adr 0002 (bill is a snapshot, never edited)

nodes.label: Bill deleted, not voided (unique renter-month index)
nodes.norm_label: bill deleted, not voided (unique renter-month index)
nodes.rationale: A hidden bill would still hold the unique (renter, month) slot, so the bill could never be made again; Undo reinserts the same id and fails if the month was retaken.

nodes.label: Only newest bill of active renter can be removed
nodes.norm_label: only newest bill of active renter can be removed
nodes.rationale: Removing older bills would break the chain of previous readings; a left renter must not regain an unbilled month.
